description: Header file defining timeout utilities and BackgroundTaskState class for managing asynchronous tasks and IPC call timeouts in Android's hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: BackgroundTaskState
classes.description: Manages the state of a background task, allowing notification and waiting with timeout.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Notifies that the background task has finished.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits until the specified end time or until the task is finished.
